data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2020 the syndicate held gross claims outstanding of GBP 184.673m at the opening of the year. Analysis of movements in the year implies a small net favourable prior-year development (approx. GBP 1.65m release on a gross basis, ~0.9% of opening gross claims). The 2020 result was nevertheless dominated by several medium-sized 2020 natural catastrophe events (Hurricanes Laura and Sally, the Iowa Derecho, Alberta hailstorms, multiple US hurricanes and wildfires) and COVID-19 related reserves (gross GBP 10.9m, net GBP 9.8m) which primarily affected property and treaty business; these were current-year losses rather than prior-year deterioration. No explicit single-line gross prior-year strengthening figure is disclosed in the notes, so the prior-year release here is calculated from the claims movement reconciliation in the claims outstanding note.
raw_causal_phrases: The loss for the year is the result of several medium sized events in 2020 which were largely under the attachment point of our catastrophe outwards protections and therefore a net loss to the syndicate.
In particular hurricanes Laura and Sally, the Iowa Derecho and the hailstorm in Alberta caused significant losses.
The overall gross COVID-19 reserve for the syndicate is GBP 10.9m, while the net reserve is GBP 9.8m with the majority coming from the Property Treaty account.
In addition, a return premium of GBP 49m net was paid to Syndicate 1955 in relation to the commutation of the whole account quota share on the 2017 & prior years of account.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit single-line 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure is provided. Prior-year development has been calculated from the claims outstanding reconciliation (opening, current-year incurred, claims paid, closing) and is therefore derived rather than explicitly stated. The document contains a claims development (triangle) table but its presentation in the text extraction is triangular and required inference; also the syndicate executed a commutation of 2017 & prior quota share (return premium) which can distort comparisons. Where line-of-business prior-year movements were not stated, LOB-level movement amounts are left null and flagged with low confidence.
